props.covers: The gate that turns run evidence into an exact-match ship set and transfers it to a stable PR campaign anchor.

text.insert: The run baseline changes only through score integration, and PR eligibility is decided separately at the run boundary. Exact scores count only with clean hard-gate evidence; improvements, stalls, and rejected hypotheses remain durable local evidence.

props.title: Candidate integration gate
rows: Selected checkpoint belongs to the target claim and edited paths stay authorized.
No target or neighbor regression; validation artifacts exist.
No unaccepted diff; runner-owned checks and repair loop settle cleanly.
Source remains understandable and local validation is preserved.
Build/report confirms old and new progress signals.

props.title: Run-boundary classes
rows: Boundary-confirmed exact match with clean hard gates.
Validated non-exact gain above configured local promotion floors.
Sub-floor gains, fact requests, stalls, errors, and rejected hypotheses.

props.title: PR promotion gate
rows: No regressions and reviewer-worthy exact-match or matched-byte evidence.
Clean local evidence without policy-qualified shipping evidence.
Broken matches, fuzzy regressions, metric regressions, or unresolved validation failure.

props.title: Split-plan lanes
rows: Boundary-confirmed exact-match candidates and required support files.
Only this lane may become PR series.
Fuzzy improvements and unassigned support work.

props.title: Slice dispositions
rows: Applies and validates alone on the current base.
Requires an explicit shared preparation slice.
Depends on an earlier review slice.
Cannot be reviewed safely as a separate slice.

text.insert: The deterministic planner assigns every changed file exactly once. An agent splitter may regroup and describe the series, but cannot add or drop files, change lanes, exceed the file ceiling, or decide eligibility; invalid output falls back to the deterministic plan.

props.title: Ship-set handoff into a PR campaign

steps.text: pause intake
drain workers; run status -> paused
pull upstream & rebase
git fetch; ff-pull master or rebase the working branch onto the base ref; newly merged PR numbers are discovered here
PR intake agents + knowledge graph rebuild
when new merged PRs were pulled, fetch their dumps, run postmortem agents, and rebuild the knowledge graph (same path as Sync Merged PRs); skipped when nothing new landed
rebuild production baseline

detached worktree at the base SHA runs configure + `ninja baseline` (cached per SHA under /tmp/melee-baseline-<sha>, shared with the melee-pr-workflow skill); baseline.json is copied into the checkout. This is the "upstream as merged, without local work" reference everything is compared against.
QA build & regression gate

`ninja changes_all` on the rebased branch, regression + promotion gates vs the new baseline. Informational: branch regressions are rework to readmit, not PR blockers, because the branch carries local-only work that never ships
checkpoint

classify worker states/checkpoints: matches ship, notable improvements and the rest carry forward; any symbol that broke an exact match or regressed against the new baseline is forced to `needs_rework`. The checkpoint lands even when the QA gate fails, so the rework ledger survives.
readmit rework
regressed symbols become priority epoch targets (same machinery as the epoch cycle), so the next working cycle fixes them first instead of leaving them parked
QA repair lane

candidate files from the checkpoint are scanned with the deterministic QA rules, error findings become per-file repair queue items, and the bounded qa-repair lane writes repair-list, report, and ship-filter artifacts. Only clean survivors continue to split planning.
plan PR slices

match slices ship, local-only slices stay; lanes merge the checkpoint items with the regression report (every new exact match in report_changes.json joins the match lane via its unit source path), so matches from earlier cycles ship even without a worker report in this run. Game configuration can use the PR splitter strategy here to reshape the deterministic seed plan into a semantic, ordered PR series before validation.
verify ship set

THE PR GATE. The match-lane diff (worktree vs the base SHA, so uncommitted work counts) is applied onto the cached baseline worktree, rebuilt incrementally, and regression-checked there, then linted with upstream CI's check-issues container (clang semantic issues like -Wself-assign permuter slop or conflicting prototypes that the MWCC match build never reports). Files with lint issues drop to rework through the same survivor loop as regressions. pr_ready means: exactly what the PRs will contain produces new matches, zero regressions against the production baseline, and zero CI lint issues, regardless of how messy the local branch is. The worktree is reset afterwards so the per-SHA cache stays valid.
reconcile & re-verify
only when the ship set is blocked: the reconcile agent (`reconcile --mode ship-validate`) gets one fix loop, then the ship set re-verifies. Prepare fails only if regressions persist after that.
replan PR slices

when the survivor loop dropped files, the split plan regenerates against the verified verdict (`pr-split-plan --ship-status`): match slices keep only files that survived ship-set verification, and dropped files ride the local lane with their drop reasons. The plan the operator ships from never needs manual subtraction.
sync PR records
the PR board seeds from the final plan (state/pr_handoff/pr_records.json), so stage 4 lists exactly what to open.
save point

a hard `ship` save point anchors the cycle and the campaign source. The operator opens one durable campaign from that stable point; the campaign persists through review, with feedback ingested while dormant and fixes reserved for operator-entered activations.
